shots.title: 1. The Night Shift — one continuous move through a rain-soaked stall

keyframe_checks.assertion: Wide alley: lit sign MIDNIGHT RAMEN legible, three noren panels hanging, cat on the counter, rain visible, cool doorway glow right.
Medium shot: cook is behind the counter stirring the broth pot; customer's hooded back occupies the left third; steam rises from the pot.
Customer lifts chopsticks toward the hood; cook's head nods; lantern and sign flicker remain subtle.
Close two-shot: counter texture, cat, bottles and both characters readable; no clipped highlights on the cook's face.
